headline: Approved one police officer appointment, three dispatcher appointments, and two hiring eligibility lists.
summary: Members approved the minutes from May 7, 2026 with no changes. They also approved one lateral appointment to Police Officer Grade II and three appointments as Public Safety Dispatcher. Members further approved eligibility lists for Patrol Officer Grade II and Probationary Firefighter from the 2026 hiring process.
decisions: Approved the minutes from May 7, 2026 with no amendments.
Approved one lateral appointment to Police Officer Grade II, passed 3-0.
Approved three appointments as Public Safety Dispatcher, passed 3-0.
Approved the certification of the eligibility list for Patrol Officer Grade II from the 2026 hiring process, passed 3-0.
Approved the certification of the eligibility list for Probationary Firefighter from the 2026 hiring process; the minutes record the vote as 3-01.
